messages:
Micah: Quick heads up — I'm prepping an SDK bump (v2.1.0) that changes auth header shape (old: `x-rw-user`, new: `x-rw-identity`). This will touch SDK, console client, backend middleware, and helm charts. PRs: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/4321, https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/8765, chart PR in infra-charts #102. Planning a staggered merge + short compatibility window. Any immediate blockers?

Tara: tagging owners to loop them in: @Jess (console), @Alvin (backend), @Nate (charts). Is runtime affected or just client/header surface? :eyes:  

Jess: Console side: client rename + proxy config. The change is limited to the client lib and the envoy config we bake into the console image. I can take the console PR review but need a stable SDK PR to depend on. Also will add a test for both header names.

Alvin: Backend: we can accept both headers for a short migration period. I'll add compatibility middleware that reads either header and logs a warning. Will need helm values to flip envoy/configmap when we promote. I can review SDK/console today.

Nate: Chart: #102 will update the default configmap and add an optional flag `accept_legacy_header: true` to toggle compatibility for canary. I can draft the chart PR but it needs the console image tag (after console PR merges) to pin.

Micah: Proposed rollout plan: 1) Merge SDK PR -> cut v2.1.0 tag. 2) Console PR updates client and Docker tag -> merge. 3) Chart PR bump (canary staging) + deploy staging with compat flag on. 4) Backend middleware shipped (dual-accept) and monitored. 5) After 24h, flip compat flag off and remove middleware. Can we target EOD Tue for SDK merge and Wed for staging canary?

Jess: EOD Tue for SDK merge ok if reviews happen this morning. I'll queue console CI after SDK tag. Adding e2e test that asserts both headers accepted — pushing a small test fix now. :white_check_mark:

Alvin: I'll submit the middleware change this afternoon. For the flip schedule, let's keep a rollback window and a brief maintenance note for SRE. Ping me when chart PR is ready to merge.

Nate: I'll open the chart PR draft now with placeholders for console image tag and a `values.acceptLegacyHeader=true` default for canary. Will update once Jess gives the image tag.

Micah: Sounds good. I'll add migration steps to the release notes (how to set the compat flag, how to monitor header usage with request logs) and mark the SDK PR as blocking console. @Jess @Alvin please add yourselves as reviewers on sdk#4321 so we can get it green.

merge-bot: merge-bot: Heads-up automation note — please ensure all PRs have matching CHANGELOG entries and release notes.

Tara: Thanks all. I'll coordinate a short deploy window with SRE once the chart PR is ready. If anything slips, drop a quick note here and we'll push the canary back. :shipit:
